parole.significato: a district (of a parish or town, for the purpose of fire fighting, road maintenance, mail forwarding, social care, etc.)
parole.testo: Old Swedish rote, from Middle French route, roupte (“disorderly flight of troops”), literally "a breaking off, rupture," from Vulgar Latin *rupta (“a dispersed group”), literally "a broken group," from Latin rupta. Related to English rout.
